Hi Emily — welcome and congrats on getting the org spun up. I’m Karthik from the solutions team; quick intro: I help match trial configs to the customer’s expected usage so you don’t over/under-provision.

Before we lock a demo, two quick clarifying questions so the session is productive:

1) Primary use case: are you planning to use Redwood for generation (chat/assistant), embeddings/semantic search, or a mix? A couple keywords/examples help a lot.
2) Expected concurrency and average request size: 1) peak concurrent requests, 2) typical tokens in/out per request (or approximate message length).
3) Ramp timeline and milestones: are you aiming for a POC in 2–4 weeks, pilot in 1–3 months, or evaluating longer-term?
4) Any constraints we should know about (SSO, region restrictions, on-prem proofs, compliance docs)?

If that looks good, here are three slots I have this week (all PT):
- Tue Jul 23 — 10:30–11:00 AM PT
- Wed Jul 24 — 2:00–2:30 PM PT
- Fri Jul 26 — 9:00–9:30 AM PT

Or grab one here: https://cal.redwood.com/karthik/30min

I’ll also attach a very small sample traffic matrix you can fill in (tokens per request, calls/day) — helps me recommend whether to start with a hosted sandbox or a small dedicated pool.

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

Karthik — thanks, and thanks for the quick follow-up. A bit about ShopFlux: we’re building an AI-powered product discovery assistant embedded in our web and mobile storefronts.

Short answers:
- Use case: generation-first (assistant/chat) with embeddings for product relevance ranking — mostly generation for customer-facing responses.
- Concurrency: expected initial peak ~30 concurrent sessions; target pilot target ~150 concurrent over 2 months.
- Tokens: average user message ~60 tokens; generated responses average ~220 tokens. Peak spiky flows for browse sessions could be larger.
- Timeline: pilot in ~6 weeks if everything looks good; POC this month to validate quality.
- Constraints: GDPR is relevant; EU region preferred for EU traffic, but initial pilot is US-only. No on-prem required for now.

We can do Wed Jul 24 at 2:00 PM PT — Tom will join as well.

—Emily
Emily Park

Two quick follow-ups so we can prepare a tailored demo:
- Can you share a short list (3–5 examples) of typical user prompts or flows you want to validate? If you’re comfortable, paste two sample prompts in the reply.
- For the EU traffic later on, we have model location routing options; curious if you need encrypted-at-rest keys under your KMS or standard Redwood-managed keys.

Agenda I’m planning for the 30m slot:
1) Quick architecture recap for the trial org (5m)
2) Walk through sample prompt flows + perf/latency expectations (10m)
3) Sizing recommendation and recommended pilot config (10m)
4) Next steps and deliverables (5m)

If anything else to add to the agenda, flag it here and I’ll adjust.

Thanks — Karthik

Thanks Karthik — quick samples pasted below:

1) User: "Find me summer running shoes in size 9 that ship free"
   Assistant goal: return 3–5 product suggestions + 1-line rationale + link to product page.

2) User: "I'm seeing 2 options in checkout — which is better for a first-time customer?"
   Assistant goal: compare options short form and point to promo eligibility logic.

3) User: "What accessories work with the TrailRunner 3000?"
   Assistant goal: list compatible accessories grouped by category, each with a short compatibility note.

On keys: for the pilot we’ll use Redwood-managed keys, but if pilot turns into a commercial rollout we’ll need KMS integration (probably AWS KMS).

See you Wed.

—Emily
